title: service-i18n: a missing translation falls back to the fallback locale, then to the key, with no signal
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the sys_user fold dev (PR #28065, os-dev report on #27858); it carries the "a missing key falls back loudly" half of #27869. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: any locale or key without a bundle entry — the user reads source-language text and nobody (operator, author, CI) is told a translation is missing.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-i18n`).

## What the code does (read, not measured)

`FileI18nAdapter.t` resolves the requested locale, then `fallbackLocale`, and returns the key when neither has it. No log line, counter or diagnostic marks the fallback.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

A fallback that is visible to someone who can fix it — for example a once-per-key warning at runtime, or a diagnostic an author's check can read — without changing what the end user sees. Decide which.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `i18n fallback`, `missing translation`, `FileI18nAdapter`, `silent` + `translation`: none. **New.**

Links back: #27869, PR #28065
